verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM ships an official desktop app that users praise, with RAG, agents and meeting transcription on-device. It also offers a hosted or self-hosted multi-user web workspace. However, the evidence never documents a mobile app or explicit feature parity between the desktop and web surfaces. Missing for 10: any official mobile app, documented feature parity across desktop/web/mobile surfaces, independent confirmation that the web deployment matches desktop features.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the assistant also meets me in official web, desktop, or mobile apps with feature parity beyond the chat basics

citations.quote: Download AnythingLLM and get a privacy-focused, extensible, and capable AI agent running on your device in minutes.
Give your whole team a private, multi-user AI workspace — hosted by us or self-hosted on your infrastructure.
I had a much smoother experience with the desktop version of AnythingLLM.
called the single-install desktop packaging very slick
